name: The Royal at Atlantis
positioning: The Royal, the central hotel of Atlantis on Paradise Island across the harbor from Nassau, home to the Royal towers and the Bridge Suite, with access to the resort's beaches, water park and marine habitats
best_for: Families who want rooms or suites steps from Aquaventure, The Dig and the casino
Travelers who want a suite with sea or harbour views and Imperial Club lounge access

facts.text: The Atlantis resort is on Paradise Island, across the harbor from Nassau.
The Royal is the center of the Atlantis resort and home to the Royal towers.
The Royal is steps from Aquaventure, The Dig and the Atlantis Casino.
The Royal's rooms and suites feature contemporary furnishings, luxurious bedding and modern amenities.
Grand Suites at The Royal have a master bedroom with Caribbean beach views and a huge walk-in closet.
Regal Suites at The Royal offer sweeping views of the Caribbean, the harbour and marina, or the tropical landscape.
Imperial Club access is included with select room categories at The Royal.
The Dig, inside The Royal, brings guests face to face with sea life including manta rays, eels and angelfish.
Plato's at The Royal offers quick bites for breakfast, dinner or a late-night snack, with live nightly entertainment.
Guests of The Royal have easy access to the Atlantis resort's white-sand beaches, open-air marine habitats, swimming pools and Aquaventure water park.
Mandara Spa at Atlantis blends Balinese healing, European therapies and natural elements unique to The Bahamas.
The Atlantis Casino links The Royal and The Coral and spans a lagoon.

highlights.text: The Bridge Suite spans the open-air connection between the East and West wings of The Royal and has been featured in many films and television productions.
The Bridge Suite has a living room with a grand piano and a dining room with a 22-karat gold chandelier.
The Royal features the mythology of the Lost City of Atlantis risen from the sea, from its lobby to The Dig.
Imperial Club at The Royal offers exclusive lounge access, enhanced services and personalized hospitality.
The Atlantis resort's marine habitats span 14 lagoons with more than 50,000 aquatic animals.

considerations.text: Atlantis Paradise Island is a cash-free resort.
For guests of The Royal, the In-Transit lounge is between the East and West wings.
WhataHotel notes a large resort property with crowds during peak seasons.
